lean.statement: ∀ (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (K : Submodule ℝ E) [CompleteSpace K] (f : E → ℝ) (a g : E) (u : K), HasGradientAt f g (a + (u : E)) → HasGradientAt (fun v : K => f (a + (v : E))) (K.orthogonalProjectionOnto g) u
approved_definition_context: HasGradientAt f g x means that f has genuine Frechet derivative v ↦ inner g v at x.
Submodule ℝ E is a real linear subspace with inherited norm and inner product. CompleteSpace supplies metric completeness.
orthogonalProjectionOnto maps an ambient vector to its orthogonal projection as a vector in the subspace.
